answer: Simultaneous Radio Echo Attestation. Each agent must, at a random challenge instant, emit a wideband probe and report the arrival times and Doppler shifts of every other agent's echo within its local mesh, cross-checked against independent anchors. A single operator cannot fabricate consistent multipath timing across physically separated nodes, since the fable of one location collapses under triangulation; even a gale of cloned radios shares one propagation signature. Cost: attacker must deploy real, spatially distinct hardware with synchronized clocks, defeating cheap duplication.
